## Slow? Not any more

Gary was always last. Then he found a rocket in a scrapyard, and **Rocket Snail** was born. Race across a galaxy of tiny planets, each small enough to run round in three seconds:

- Hold **A** to fire the rocket, let go to coast. Fuel is short.
- Skim a planet and its *gravity* bends your path. Time the release to slingshot to the next one.
- Overshoot into deep space and you drift back to the last checkpoint, very slowly.

Pull into your shell with **B** to bounce off asteroids and the one-eyed space slug who wants your trophy.

## Four worlds

Mushroom meadows, lava rocks, ice moons and the candy rings, 32 tracks in all. Stars you collect buy new shells and boosters in the garage.
